title: Metropolis Bratislava Apartment Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 75 m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 75 m² apartment interior design in Metropolis, Bratislava by DUMSKAYA DESIGN. 3D visualizations, technical documentation, custom furniture, lighting and décor selection, and design supervision.
h1: Apartment Interior Design in Metropolis, Bratislava, Custom Furniture, 75 m²

blocks.text: Apartment Interior Design in Metropolis, Bratislava, Custom Furniture, 75 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed the interior design for a 75 m² apartment in the Metropolis residential complex in Bratislava. Located in the central part of the city, the apartment was delivered with basic developer finishes. The main objective was to create a contemporary, functional and comfortable space for modern urban living.

The central area of the apartment is an open-plan kitchen and living room, combining cooking, dining and relaxation zones. The layout also includes a bedroom, a home office that can later be transformed into a children’s room, a functional laundry room, bathroom and entrance hall with carefully planned storage solutions.

The project was developed within the Furniture Design Package and includes the interior concept, photorealistic 3D visualizations, technical documentation, as well as the design and production of custom-made cabinetry in Bratislava.

The custom furniture was developed as an integral part of the interior, allowing the available space to be used efficiently and storage systems to be seamlessly integrated into the architecture of the apartment. Upholstered furniture, lighting and decorative elements were also selected for the project.

The interior follows a contemporary minimalist style with a light neutral color palette, natural materials and understated decorative solutions. All interior and furniture elements were adapted to the client’s budget while maintaining a balance between aesthetics, practicality and quality. The project was also supported by DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s design supervision.
